(rule! (let ((dummy 0))
  (define dirs4 (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
  (define (e15b-region-dots grid region)
    (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells region))
           (r1 (max 1 (- (first bb) 1)))
           (c1 (max 0 (- (second bb) 1)))
           (r2 (min (- (rows grid) 1) (+ (third bb) 1)))
           (c2 (min (- (cols grid) 1) (+ (fourth bb) 1))))
      (filter
        (lambda (p)
          (and (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 1)
               (any? (lambda (d)
                       (member? (list (+ (first p) (first d))
                                      (+ (second p) (second d)))
                                region))
                     dirs4)))
        (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2))))
  (define (anchor-dot? grid p)
    (and (= (first p) 2)
         (= (at grid (first p) (- (second p) 1)) 8)))
  (let* ((legend
           (filter values
             (for/list ((c (in-range (cols g))))
               (let ((v (at g 0 c)))
                 (if (= v 0) #f (list c v))))))
         (body (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
         (regions
           (map (lambda (region)
                  (map (lambda (p) (list (+ 1 (first p)) (second p))) region))
                (find-0-regions body 0)))
         (records
           (map (lambda (region) (list region (e15b-region-dots g region))) regions))
         (anchor-records
           (filter (lambda (record)
                     (any? (lambda (p) (anchor-dot? g p)) (second record)))
                   records))
         (anchor-count (length (second (first anchor-records)))))
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((record (in-list records)))
      (let* ((region (first record))
             (dots (second record))
             (n (length dots))
             (slot (+ 1 (modulo (- n anchor-count) 3)))
             (hit (filter (lambda (pair) (= (first pair) slot)) legend)))
        (if (empty? hit)
            out
            (paint-cells out (append region dots) (second (first hit)))))))))
